title: 第1章 落魄子弟长生路第2章 坐怀不乱
content_zh:
陈观楼掘地三尺，从家里翻出十两银子，置办礼物。
钱不多，礼物就要大，越大越体面。他置办了两只风干鸡，两只风干鸭，担心收礼的人嫌弃，又添置了两块酱肉，封了一包银子，前往平江侯府后巷刘管事家。
来到刘府，嘿，好气派的宅子，两进的院落。侯府一管事，都住上了老爷们才能住的大宅子，不得了。
侯府富贵啊！
三步台阶上前，拉起大门上的铜环，敲击三下。
不一会，大门隔壁的侧门开了，一个年轻的门房伸出头来瞧着他，见他面生，穿得也不咋样，那神情，眼睛立马长在了头顶上。
陈观楼赶紧上前，陪着笑，“麻烦小哥通报一声刘管事，我是隔壁东巷的陈观楼，陈承宗的儿子。”
说罢，从兜里掏出几个铜板，手法不太熟练的塞入年轻门房的手中。
十个铜板，陈观楼心疼啊。好在面上不显，手不抖，表现出手面很阔的样子。
门房收了钱，态度立马一改，露了一张笑脸，“等着。”
话音一落，啪的一声，侧门关了。
陈观楼：……
他只能站在门前，耐心等着。
平江侯府姓陈，陈观楼也姓陈，一个祖宗传下来的。只可惜，陈观楼投生太晚，没赶上好时候。到陈观楼父亲这一辈的时候，同侯府已经出了五服。以前祭祀的时候，还能同侯府的主家们见一面，如今连祭祀都没资格参加。侯府早就不认他们这群出了五服的亲戚。
说是亲戚，都是客气话。
堂堂第一代平江侯后人，如今连侯府的下人都不如。遇到事，还得求到侯府管事头上，用心置办礼物，生怕人家嫌弃不肯帮忙。
陈冠楼家里早在祖父那一辈就已经败落，成了破落户。无奈之下，干起了贱业，在天牢谋了个职缺。
这差事好啊，父传子，子传孙，妥妥的世袭制，顶班制，铁得不能再铁的铁饭碗，安全性还有保证。只要不嫌弃这一行低贱被人看不起，可以一直干到老干到死。
中途死了，那是命不好。
陈观楼的父亲，就属于命不好的人。在陈观楼十岁那年，因公牺牲。第二年，母亲忧思成疾，也走了。他是长姐拉扯大了。长姐前些年嫁了人，带着他这个拖油瓶，暗地里受了不少婆家气。

如今，陈观楼年十八，到了可以顶班继承父业的年纪。堂堂男子汉，也不能一直跟着长姐吃姐夫家喝姐夫家，得尽早立起来。
陈观楼前面十八年，一直浑浑噩噩，受到当世社会风气，他人言语的影响，一直抗拒继承父业，口口声声说那是贱业，为此长姐暗地里哭了好多回。
直到两个月前，他突然觉醒宿慧，想起了上辈子的事情。上辈子生活在现代，什么低贱不低贱是不存在的，妥妥的铁饭碗，傻子才拒绝。
content_en:
Chen Guanlou dug three feet into the ground and dug out ten taels of silver from his home to buy gifts.
If you don't have much money, the gift should be big. The bigger the gift, the more respectable it is. He bought two air-dried chickens and two air-dried ducks. Worried that the recipients would dislike them, he bought two more pieces of soy sauce meat, sealed a bag of silver, and went to Steward Liu's house in the back alley of Pingjiang Hou Mansion.
When I came to Liu's Mansion, hey, it's such a grand house with a courtyard with two entrances. All the officials in the Hou Mansion live in big houses that only gentlemen can live in, which is incredible.
The Hou Mansion is rich and noble!
Go up the three steps, pull up the brass ring on the door, and knock three times.
After a while, the side door next to the main door opened, and a young concierge stretched out his head to look at him. Seeing that he looked unfamiliar and was not well-dressed, his eyes immediately appeared on the top of his head.
Chen Guanlou hurried forward and laughed with him, "Brother, please inform Manager Liu. I am Chen Guanlou from the east alley next door, the son of Chen Chengzong."
After that, he took out a few copper coins from his pocket and stuffed them into the hands of the young concierge unskillfully.
Ten copper coins made Chen Guanlou feel distressed. Fortunately, it doesn't show on the face and the hands don't shake, showing that the hands are very generous.
The concierge took the money and immediately changed his attitude, showing a smile and said, "Wait."
As soon as he finished speaking, the side door closed with a snap.
Chen Guanlou:......
He could only stand in front of the door and wait patiently.
The surname of Pingjiang Marquis is Chen, and Chen Guanlou is also surnamed Chen, passed down from one ancestor. It's a pity that Chen Guanlou was reincarnated too late and did not catch up with the good time. By the time of Chen Guanlou's father's generation, Tonghou Mansion had already released five servers. In the past, during the sacrifices, one could meet with the heads of the Marquis Mansion, but now they are not even eligible to participate in the sacrifices. The Hou Mansion has long since disowned these relatives who came out of the fifth service.
To say they are relatives is just a polite word.
The dignified first generation descendants of Pingjiang Marquis are now inferior to even the servants of the Marquis Mansion. When something goes wrong, you have to go to the steward of the Hou Mansion and buy gifts carefully, for fear that others will dislike you and refuse to help.
Chen Guanlou's family had been in decline as early as his grandfather's generation and had become a shabby settlement. In desperation, he took up a lowly job and found a job in Tianlao.
This is a good job. It is passed down from father to son, and from son to grandson. It is a perfect hereditary system and a top-shift system. It is an iron rice bowl that cannot be more iron-clad and the safety is guaranteed. As long as you don't dislike the lowliness of this profession and being looked down upon by others, you can continue to work until you die.
If you die midway, that is a bad fate.
Chen Guanlou's father is a person with bad luck. When Chen Guanlou was ten years old, he died in the line of duty. The next year, my mother became ill with worry and passed away. He was raised by his eldest sister. The eldest sister got married a few years ago, and with him being a dragster, she secretly suffered a lot from her husband's family.
Now, Chen Guanlou is eighteen years old and is old enough to take over his father's business. A man who is a dignified man cannot always follow his eldest sister to eat at his brother-in-law's house and drink at his brother-in-law's house. He must stand up as soon as possible.
Chen Guanlou had been in a state of confusion for the past eighteen years. Affected by the social climate of the world and other people's words, he had always resisted inheriting his father's business, saying that it was a lowly business. For this reason, the eldest sister secretly cried many times.
Until two months ago, he suddenly woke up from Su Hui and remembered what happened in his previous life. In my previous life, I lived in modern times. There was no such thing as lowliness or lowliness. Only fools would refuse the iron rice bowl.
